svg.aria-label: S19 The L1 data cache, set by set and bank by bank
svg.text: S19 The L1 data cache, set by set and bank by bank
A template where the player marks the set, way and bank a line uses. The micro tag picks the way, and a tree PLRU picks the victim.
◆ The index sits inside the page offset.
So the set is picked before the dTLB answers.
○ Bits 7:4 pick the bank, two of them in the index.
◆ The micro tag XOR-folds 8 bits from 47:14.
A cell is one 64 B line with its tag, state and data.
○ A tree PLRU over the 8 ways picks the victim.
? A hash of page bits may fix a line's way.
Empty cells mean nothing else is resident.
8 bits of hashed virtual address per way
one way read on a match
the PLRU victim, dirty lines written back
its L2 copy keeps the data
~ Loads to one bank share an access, and stores wait.
~ A fill writes a bank and blocks its loads that cycle.
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
